title: Fornax DEMO
features:
Simple, Sleek, Welcoming.


Update 8/30/25 - 3:58 pm : Scripts menu now (should hopefully) get any script you search for from ScriptBlox.com through the api. I wasn't able to fully test the execution as Cloudflare blocked me temporarily but should work. Also fixed the view on mobile, drag support for mobile soon

Update 8/30/25 : Added a scripts menu, I will attempt to find you the user the best possible scripts whenever I can, if it can make you experience with Fornax more comfortable, I'm trying. If a key is known for a script we have it will be automatically copied where possible. I am also working on a copy intercept feature to prevent unknown text being copied without your knowledge.

At the minute, this is just a demo. In the near future we plan to make this a revolutionary script. As of right now we are still busy developing Fornax but updates are to come.

Currently, we have some basic feature like noclip, fling, fly ,low gravity but i will be adding more in the near future as this project is quite recent.

Any issues/bugs or recommendations send to @4g5q on Discord.
